comparison: Records agreed comparison conditions; the runner does not read this file. Keep Cases, Judges, model and execution options identical. Round 01 changes instructions only; round 02 changes the documented process and citation tools. Retain every attempt and error; do not select reruns.
sourceDrift: Exa is live search. Preserve actual query/source metadata; a single-run score change does not establish statistical significance. Model aliases may change upstream; no underlying model fingerprint is claimed.
annotation: Review notes are local analysis of actual trajectories, not hosted Builder Annotation exports.

runner.policy: One runner for all three rounds; runtime reported version is recorded in each native run. No platform fixes are attributed to Agent improvement.

regressionScope: All three rounds execute the same four development cases and clarify-breakfast. Other 8 single-turn and 5 multi-turn cases are not run in this comparison; this is not full-suite acceptance.
snapshotGuarantee: Manifest verification checks this round source content only, excluding generated node_modules/.gea/dist. It does not enforce experiment conditions or verify outcomes.
trace: Published traces are cropped sharing exports; complete native evidence stays local. Missing text in a sharing export does not establish absence in the native trace.
